description: Individual liquidation events from the futures venues that publish a public liquidation feed, newest first. `events` is an array of { ts, exchange, symbol, side, price, quantity, notional }: `ts` is the venue's time in epoch milliseconds, `side` is the POSITION liquidated (a long is closed by a forced sell), `quantity` is in base units and `notional` in the quote currency. `from`/`to` (ISO-8601) default to the last hour, echoed as `fromIso`/`toIso`; `limit` is 1 to 1000 (default 100) and `truncated: true` means the window held more. Feed coverage per venue is `futures.venues[].liquidations` in blackforge_catalog: `complete` sends every liquidation, `lowerBound` is throttled by the venue so a cascade is undercounted, null publishes none; `feedNote` names the lower-bound venues present in the result. Max, Ultra and PAYG; below Max this is an HTTP 403 with an upgrade URL.

exchange.description: One futures venue. Omitted: every venue with a feed the plan includes.

from.description: Start datetime, ISO-8601. Default: one hour before `to`.

side.description: The position liquidated: long or short.

symbol.description: One contract, as the venue spells it.

name: blackforge_futures_liquidations
title: BlackForge futures liquidations
